page.layout: One printed page. Full-width ornamental headpiece at top; below it the dedication text in one column of full-width lines. A bracketed group of names at upper left has a bracket note at right ("Illustr. Reip. San-Gallensis..."), and a second bracket note at right beside the Hoeggero lines ("Agnatis suis ad aras usq; venerandis"). Catchword-like word "NEC" at lower right, set apart. Faint show-through text in the lower centre is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Dn. TOBIÆ SCHOBINGERO, Senatûs quotidiani Assessori
fidissimo, Quæsturâ quondam ad Patriæ bonum summâ cum
laude defuncto, Patrono suo nunquam non honorando.
Senatori prudentissimo, suo è Sacro baptismatis
BUS &c. Patribus Patriæ. Mœcenatibus suis omni obsequiorum

marginalia.note: Illustr. Reip. San-Gallensis Consulibus Prudentissimis, Dn. Mœcenatibus ac Fautoribus meis summâ observantiâ omni tempore colendis.
Agnatis suis ad aras usq; venerandis.

page.notes: The bracket note at upper right and the bracket note beside the Hoeggero lines are marginal; the Hoeggero note is placed at its line. Names in the first group are set with the bracket and transcribed as separate lines. The word "NEC" at lower right is a catchword-like fragment. Faint show-through in the lower centre is omitted.
